notFound.heading: Screen not found

errorState.title: Something went wrong
errorState.body: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

code.OFFLINE: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
code.SESSION_ENDED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
code.JOB_ALREADY_TAKEN: Another technician accepted this job first.
code.JOB_ESCALATED: This job has gone to your Area Service Manager.
code.NOT_ACCEPTING_WORK: You're not accepting work right now — turn availability back on to take jobs.
code.NO_WINDOW_LEFT: You have no free window left inside this job's service level. Finish or free up a day and it will come back.
code.DAILY_CAP_REACHED: You already have your daily limit of jobs on that day. Raise it under Availability & bandwidth.
code.NO_TIME_AGREED: The customer hasn't picked a time yet. You can start this job once they do, or once your manager sets one.
code.JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This job can no longer be cancelled.
code.JOB_NOT_RESCHEDULABLE: This job can't be rescheduled right now. Refresh to see where it is.
code.SLOT_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE: That time is no longer free — pick another.
code.BAD_CODE: That code didn't match. Request a new one.
code.BALANCE_CHANGED: Your balance has changed. Check the new amount and try again.
code.NOTHING_TO_REDEEM: There is nothing to redeem yet.
code.REDEMPTION_OPEN: You already have a redemption open. It has to be paid and confirmed, or declined, before you can ask for another.
code.NOT_CLAIMED: Nobody has marked this as paid yet, so there is nothing to confirm.
code.ALREADY_CONFIRMED: You have already confirmed you received this.
code.UPI_ALREADY_SET: You already have a UPI ID. To change it, send a change request.
code.SAME_UPI_ID: That is already your UPI ID.
code.CHANGE_PENDING: You already have a change waiting. Withdraw it to ask for a different one.
code.NO_PENDING_CHANGE: There is no change waiting — it may already have been decided or withdrawn.
code.NO_PHONE: Your account has no mobile number to send a code to. Ask your manager.
code.TECHNICIAN_HAS_OPEN_JOBS: You still have open jobs. Finish them, or ask your manager to reassign them, first.
code.RANGE_TOO_LONG: Pick a shorter range of dates.
code.UPDATE_APP: Update the app to add or change your UPI ID.
